items.title: The polynomial piece of the Mor space is separated of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove Mor^{P,M}_B(Y,X) -> B is separated of finite presentation for ample L on X/B and N on Y/B with M = pr1^*N tensor pr2^*L: separatedness and lfp come from lemma-Mor-s-lfp, reducing to quasi-compactness of the open-and-closed P-piece; etale-locally descend Y, X, L, N along Lambda = colim Lambda_i via five Limits lemmas (finite presentation, invertible modules, separatedness, eventual properness, limit-ample); on Noetherian affine B, M is ample (properties-lemma-ample-on-product) and Hilb^{P,M}_{Y x_B X/B} is of finite presentation over B hence Noetherian (lemma-hilb-qc-over-base), and Mor^{P,M}_B(Y,X) = Mor_B(Y,X) intersect Hilb^{P,M} is an open subspace of a Noetherian algebraic space, hence quasi-compact.
